recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit decision. No core FHIR source change is recommended; any future content correction to medication-manufacturingBatch should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions rather than reintroducing the extension source into core.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy change request for R5 asking to add a string Container Lot Number to Medication.Batch, distinct from the drug product batch/lot number; the approved resolution was to create a core extension.
initial_application: No commit message explicitly names FHIR-29570. Git history shows the content was applied through the Medication manufacturing-batch extension family: 5faa63a834 added manufacturingBatch.container.lotNumber and its definition to the old core medication extension spreadsheet, 33b409a4b6 generated structuredefinition-extension-medication-manufacturingBatch.xml with container.lotNumber as a string sub-extension, and dd468d4f17 removed that extension source from core when R5 extensions moved out. The Extension Pack imported the extension in 4087c90 and retained the differential after snapshot cleanup in 51879de.
additional_context: Medication is still an active core resource, but current source/fhir.ini maps the historical Medication.batch path to Medication.instance and core retains only the OID registry entry for medication-manufacturingBatch. The FHIR Extension Pack currently defines medication-manufacturingBatch with context Medication.batch and includes Extension.extension:container.extension:lotNumber using the requested manufacturing-lot definition and string value. Pharmacy minutes on 2020-11-09 confirm the block vote to add a core extension for this PQ/CMC batch issue family. A 2022 Zulip thread discussed profiling the same standard extension and an old generated nested-extension max=0 problem; the current Extension Pack differential no longer carries that conflicting generated snapshot content.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined core branch and made no HL7/fhir source changes. The current core checkout does not own the extension definition, and the external Extension Pack source already carries the requested slice.
